create_index_client: create an IndexClient to connect to distributed FAISS servers using a server list file path
search_distributed_index: search a distributed FAISS index with query vectors and return top-k nearest neighbor results
add_index_data: add embedding vectors with optional metadata to a distributed FAISS index using round-robin load balancing
search_with_filter: search a distributed FAISS index and filter results by a metadata field position and value
load_and_create_index: load or create a distributed FAISS index on all connected servers with an optional configuration
